title: Replace deprecated gemini-2.0-flash-live-001 with gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio
body:
`gemini-2.0-flash-live-001` has been removed by Google from the v1beta API, causing the Live WebSocket session (`BidiGenerateContent`) to reject all requests with a "model not found" error.

## Changes

- **`index.html`**: Swap the Live model dropdown value from `gemini-2.0-flash-live-001` → `gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio` (GA replacement per Google's migration guide)

No logic changes needed — `isLiveModel()` matches on `"live"` substring, which the new model name still satisfies, so WebSocket routing remains intact.
